verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's official start-parameters docs give a one-line batch conversion command (`--convert-to pdf:writer_pdf_Export --outdir ... *.doc`), plus a headless mode for running without a UI, and a filter list naming the supported formats. A community user independently reports running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize document formats, which corroborates scripted use. missing for 10: explicit CI-oriented guidance (e.g. exit codes or error handling for unattended pipelines).

support.subject: As a developer, a documented command converts a file in one line, usable from scripts and CI

citations.quote: Starts in "headless mode" which allows using the application without user interface.
Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
